Note: SW 0.1.4. Bumping SW_SUB2 from x3 to x4 moved combinational logic by itself (pcb -25, dev_open +14, registers and memory untouched, slack improved): the version digits are constants that feed the boot info display and the ASCII string for LISY opcode 1, so a different nibble folds differently. Expect that on every version bump - it is not a design change. 2026-08-09 lamp_matrix got the extra FSM state St_ShiftLast (+1 register in one-hot, +6 comb, slack 3.142 -> 2.683 which is well inside the 1.5 ns tolerance): the 24th SRCK pulse used to be one clock period = 20 ns wide, right at the 74HC595 minimum, measured on the logic analyser - see docs/Lamp_Refresh_Analysis.md 6.7.1. Lead variant, hardware tested through SW 0.1.3 (FA-Control interface tested on the prototype 2026-08-08 and working). These are the SYNTHESIS numbers. The jump from 2433/935 came with rtl/fa_control (LISY slave for the ESP32 web UI): the module itself is 1700 ALUTs / 499 registers, the rest is the override muxing in the top level. Memory is UNCHANGED at 202752 - the module is all registers, no BRAM, and that was the acceptance criterion because BRAM at 73 percent is the tight resource, not LEs. LEfit went 2545 -> 4402 (70 percent) and slack IMPROVED from 2.304 to 3.142. Still 85 of 89 pins: ESP32_sig only changed direction (now the input ESP32_ctrl_req), no pin was added. The 'solenoids[14]/[18] stuck at VCC' warnings are GONE on purpose - those outputs are no longer constant because FA-Control can address all 20 solenoid positions (14 and 18 are unpopulated on the board, so nothing happens physically).
